question: From which root center is the foundational lotus to be contemplated, O pure-smiling great goddess?
premises: The root support is named as a locus.
The instruction is addressed to the great goddess.
inference: The practice begins from the mūlādhāra with attention to the root lotus.
uncertainties: The governing verb is carried over from the surrounding context.
plain_english: O great goddess, pure-smiling one, from the root support, contemplate the root lotus.
